title: Route fcitx5 D-Bus activation through omarchy-fcitx5.service
head: 722c0068eab8
workflow: Opus full review, Sol boundary hunter, Opus self-check of the draft, editorial check, batch gates

leads.summary: An ordinary unowned fcitx5 bus name aborts all pending migrations
leads.consequence: During a live graphical session with fcitx5 not running or its name briefly unowned, busctl status returns nonzero. The sed pipeline inherits that status under pipefail; the command-substitution assignment exits the bash -e migration before MainPID or the conditional restart. bin/omarchy-migrate:88-97 never writes this migration marker or executes later pending migrations; the next update retries and fails again until the name becomes owned. A sealed stub run returned exit 1 for unowned, 0 for healthy and stray owners.

leads.summary: Migration can complete before its activation file is installed, permanently skipping its only explicit reload
leads.consequence: #704 is an independent open package PR. If the runtime migration arrives first, ReloadConfig succeeds before the override exists and the migration can mark itself complete (healthy owner or no graphical session). When #704 later creates /usr/local/share/dbus-1/services for the first time, dbus-broker v37 did not watch that absent directory at startup (opendir ENOENT returns before dirwatch_add). It therefore keeps the package's bare fcitx5 activation until a future explicit reload or broker restart, despite an already-complete marker. Also a transient/invalid-config ReloadConfig failure is explicitly ignored and marked complete on the healthy-owner or inactive-session path. Gate completion on installed file and successful reload when a user bus is available, or arrange a guaranteed reload in the package install hook.

leads.summary: Related #10578 cannot merge its test alongside this PR without resolving a conflict
leads.consequence: Open non-stacked #10578 replaces the exact fcitx5 ExecStart assertion adjacent to this PR's inserted D-Bus assertion. A three-way merge (this head, pinned merge-base, #10578 head) exits 1 with conflict markers at line 62 of the test. Resolve with #10578's updated --disable notificationitem,notifications assertion and retain this PR's SystemdService assertion; otherwise the new test cannot execute after both merge. GitHub currently reports #10578 itself MERGEABLE against current quattro, not against this head.

leads.summary: New D-Bus activation assertion passes with a wrong bus name
leads.consequence: The new test greps only SystemdService, so changing Name= to a different valid bus name leaves it green while dbus-broker will ignore that file for org.fcitx.Fcitx5 activation (and warns about a filename/name mismatch). Include assertions for Name and Exec, check the installed file path in the package test, and ideally test activation or duplicate-file precedence. This is source-derived test-fidelity evidence, not a run of the full test suite.

leads.summary: File-layout map misses the new static D-Bus activation file
leads.consequence: The documentation enumerates default/** files and their installed paths, including existing user units and another /usr/local/share file, but has no entry for default/dbus-1/services/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.service -> /usr/local/share/dbus-1/services/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.service. Developers consulting the build-time map will not see the new package destination; add a row after the user-service entry.

limits: Source-only for D-Bus integration; no private real bus, fcitx5 process or host manager touched. Sandbox run exercised migration with stubs and did not execute repository-wide tests. Related-open-PR search returned many generic results for broad file names: focused diff and merged-result checks on #10578 and the fcitx5/session overlaps listed in inventory.json; not a claim of exhaustive diff inspection of every search result.

The upstream systemd source evidence is tag v257 rather than a verified package build on the author's machine. The conditional #704 version-skew scenario depends on independent package release timing and on the directory being initially absent; if package PR is merged before the runtime PR, that ordering removes this condition.

comment:
## Automated AI review

> **Community review:** Independent automated community review, unaffiliated with the Omarchy team, intended to help prepare PRs for their review.

**Outcome:** The new migration can abort `omarchy update`.

### Migration fails when fcitx5 is not running

Migrations run under `bash -euo pipefail`. In a graphical session where nothing owns `org.fcitx.Fcitx5` (unit stopped, failed or disabled), `busctl --user status` exits 1 and line 11 ends the migration silently. **Impact:** later migrations stay pending and `omarchy update` fails until fcitx5 runs again.

**Suggested change:** add `|| true` to line 11 and the reproducer as a test.

<details><summary>Reproducer (fails at 722c0068)</summary>

Save as `test/shell.d/fcitx5-dbus-activation-migration-test.sh` in the PR checkout (head 722c0068) and run `bash test/shell.d/fcitx5-dbus-activation-migration-test.sh`. It stubs `busctl`, `systemctl` and `omarchy-restart-xcompose`, and runs the migration with the same `bash -euo pipefail` that `omarchy-migrate` uses.

```bash
#!/bin/bash

set -euo pipefail

source "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/base-test.sh"

migration="$ROOT/migrations/1790604026.sh"
test_dir=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$test_dir"' EXIT

stub_bin="$test_dir/bin"
mkdir -p "$stub_bin"

# busctl answers `status` the way the real one does: a PID= line when someone
# owns the name, or exit 1 when nobody does. ReloadConfig just succeeds.
cat >"$stub_bin/busctl" <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
if [[ $* == *" status org.fcitx.Fcitx5" ]]; then
  if [[ -z ${TEST_OWNER_PID:-} ]]; then
    echo "Failed to get credentials: No such device or address" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
  printf 'PID=%s\nPPID=1\nUID=1000\n' "$TEST_OWNER_PID"
fi
SH

# A graphical session is running; MainPID is whatever the case says.
cat >"$stub_bin/systemctl" <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
case "$*" in
  "--user is-active --quiet graphical-session.target") exit 0 ;;
  "--user show --property MainPID --value omarchy-fcitx5.service") echo "${TEST_MAIN_PID:-0}" ;;
  *) exit 1 ;;
esac
SH

cat >"$stub_bin/omarchy-restart-xcompose" <<'SH'
#!/bin/bash
echo restart >>"$TEST_CALLS"
SH
chmod +x "$stub_bin"/*

calls="$test_dir/calls"

# Same shell options omarchy-migrate runs every migration with.
run_migration() {
  rm -f "$calls"
  TEST_CALLS="$calls" PATH="$stub_bin:$PATH" bash -euo pipefail "$migration" >/dev/null 2>&1
}

TEST_OWNER_PID=4242 TEST_MAIN_PID=4242 run_migration ||
  fail "migration succeeds when the unit owns the bus name"
[[ ! -e $calls ]] || fail "migration restarts a healthy unit"
pass "migration leaves a healthy unit alone"

TEST_OWNER_PID=5151 TEST_MAIN_PID=0 run_migration ||
  fail "migration succeeds when a D-Bus activated fcitx5 owns the bus name"
[[ -e $calls ]] || fail "migration hands a D-Bus activated fcitx5 back to the unit"
pass "migration hands a D-Bus activated fcitx5 back to the unit"

# Nobody owns org.fcitx.Fcitx5: the user stopped or disabled the unit, removed
# fcitx5, or it is between restarts. busctl status exits 1 here, and under
# pipefail that fails the assignment, errexit stops the migration, and
# omarchy-migrate stops the queue (and omarchy update with it).
TEST_MAIN_PID=0 run_migration ||
  fail "migration fails when nothing owns org.fcitx.Fcitx5"
[[ ! -e $calls ]] || fail "migration restarts fcitx5 when nothing owns its bus name"
pass "migration leaves a session without fcitx5 alone"
```

Actual output at 722c0068 (exit status 1):

```
ok - migration leaves a healthy unit alone
ok - migration hands a D-Bus activated fcitx5 back to the unit
not ok - migration fails when nothing owns org.fcitx.Fcitx5
```

Actual output after changing only line 11 of `migrations/1790604026.sh` (exit status 0):

```diff
-  owner=$(busctl --user status org.fcitx.Fcitx5 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^PID=//p')
+  owner=$(busctl --user status org.fcitx.Fcitx5 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/^PID=//p') || true
```

```
ok - migration leaves a healthy unit alone
ok - migration hands a D-Bus activated fcitx5 back to the unit
ok - migration leaves a session without fcitx5 alone
```

The stubbed `busctl` matches the real one. Against a private session bus run by dbus-broker 37, with activation files for `org.fcitx.Fcitx5` present but nothing owning the name, systemd 261.2's `busctl --user status org.fcitx.Fcitx5` printed `Failed to get credentials: No such device or address` and exited 1 without starting an activation. The unmodified migration, run with that real `busctl` and a stubbed `systemctl` that reports an active graphical session, exited 1 after printing only its `echo` line. Run through `bin/omarchy-migrate` with a later migration queued behind it, the runner printed (colour codes and the leading blank line removed):

```
Running migration (1790604026)
Route fcitx5 D-Bus activation through omarchy-fcitx5.service
```

and exited 1 with an empty stderr. It wrote no marker for 1790604026 and did not run the later migration.
</details>

### omarchy-pkgs#704 packaging gaps

`omarchy-settings` is pinned to v4.0.4, which lacks `default/dbus-1/`, so #704's new install line fails `package()`. **Impact:** the release build fails at that pin; on the dev channel, `omarchy-dev` ships the migration but `omarchy-settings-dev` lacks the override.

**Suggested change:** guard that line with `if [[ -f … ]]` like the plocate drop-in, and add it to `omarchy-settings-dev`.

<details><summary>Reproducer (package() run locally, not in CI)</summary>

omarchy-pkgs#704 (head 748f8210) adds an unconditional install of `default/dbus-1/services/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.service` to `pkgbuilds/omarchy-settings/PKGBUILD`. That PKGBUILD pins `_commit='c668141e9c42b13c80c9ca4ea108e11708c5e8a5'` (v4.0.4), and that commit has no `default/dbus-1/` directory:

```
$ git ls-tree c668141e9c42b13c80c9ca4ea108e11708c5e8a5 default/ | grep -E 'dbus|wayland'
040000 tree a1bad1507ff1841c92b4d0d469a4d16e65c48c1b	default/wayland-sessions
```

Harness: source the PKGBUILD, copy an omarchy checkout to `$srcdir/omarchy`, and call `package()` with errexit, errtrace and an ERR trap, which is how makepkg's `run_function_safe` runs it. `magick` is stubbed so icon conversion cannot fail for an unrelated reason.

```bash
run_package() {
  local label=$1 pkgbuild=$2 tree=$3 carch=${4:-x86_64}
  local work=/tmp/pkg-$label
  mkdir -p "$work/src" "$work/pkg"
  cp -a "$tree" "$work/src/omarchy"
  (
    cd "$work"
    export PATH="$stub:/usr/bin:/bin" CARCH=$carch srcdir="$work/src" pkgdir="$work/pkg"
    source "$pkgbuild"
    shopt -o -s errexit errtrace
    trap 'echo "ERR: package() stopped at: $BASH_COMMAND" >&2' ERR
    package
  )
}
```

Actual results:

| PKGBUILD | omarchy source | exit | override in package |
|---|---|---|---|
| omarchy-pkgs master 660cbe39, `omarchy-settings` | c668141e (its pin) | 0 | no |
| #704 748f8210, `omarchy-settings` | c668141e (its pin) | 1 | no |
| #704 748f8210, `omarchy-settings` | 722c0068 (this PR) | 0 | yes, mode 644 |
| #704 748f8210, `omarchy-settings-dev` | 722c0068 (this PR) | 0 | no |

stderr of the failing run:

```
install: cannot stat 'default/dbus-1/services/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.service': No such file or directory
ERR: package() stopped at: install -Dm644 default/dbus-1/services/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.service "$pkgdir/usr/local/share/dbus-1/services/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.service"
```

Files that are newer than the release pin already use a guard in the release PKGBUILD, for example lines 237-240 of #704's `pkgbuilds/omarchy-settings/PKGBUILD`:

```bash
  # Older release pins still configure locate through install/config/locate.sh.
  if [[ -f default/systemd/system/plocate-updatedb.service.d/10-omarchy.conf ]]; then
    install -Dm644 default/systemd/system/plocate-updatedb.service.d/10-omarchy.conf "$pkgdir/usr/lib/systemd/system/plocate-updatedb.service.d/10-omarchy.conf"
  fi
```

`pkgbuilds/omarchy-settings-dev/PKGBUILD` is pinned to each quattro tip (its header: "every quattro tip becomes a commit pin here"), and #704 does not change it. The last row shows that when the dev package is built from this PR's commit, it does not install the override under `/usr/local/share`.
</details>

<details><summary>Details</summary>

**Verified**
- With the override earlier in the search path, dbus-broker 37 asks systemd for `StartUnit omarchy-fcitx5.service` instead of a transient unit running `/usr/bin/fcitx5` (private bus, stand-in systemd).
- For a services directory created after the broker started, activation stays transient until the migration's `ReloadConfig` call, then uses the unit.
- Name owned by the unit's MainPID: no restart. Owned by another PID: one `omarchy-restart-xcompose` call.
- `systemd-test.sh` passes at head and fails at the merge-base and with `SystemdService=` removed. `config-test.sh` passes at head against #704 and fails against omarchy-pkgs master until #704 merges.

**Optional notes**
- `systemd-test.sh` does not check `Name=org.fcitx.Fcitx5`: with `Name=org.fcitx.Fcitx4` it still passes.
- With `SYSTEMD_COLORS=1`, `busctl` colours the `PID=` value even into a pipe, so the comparison fails and a healthy unit is restarted (reproduced; Omarchy does not set this variable). `SYSTEMD_COLORS=0` on that call avoids it.
- `docs/file-layout.md` does not list the new `/usr/local/share/dbus-1/services/` destination next to `wayland-sessions`.

**Related PR:** open #10578 changes the adjacent `ExecStart` assertion in `test/shell.d/systemd-test.sh`, and a three-way merge with this PR conflicts there. Keeping #10578's `ExecStart` assertion and this PR's `SystemdService=` assertion resolves it.
</details>
